explanation: King of Israel and son of David, known for his wisdom and wealth.
Women from other nations whom Solomon married, in violation of God's command.

A goddess of fertility who was worshiped in several Canaanite and Near Eastern cultures.
An Ammonite god, also known as Molech, often worshiped through human sacrifice.
An Israelite chosen by God to rule the ten northern tribes after the kingdom was divided.
A person who speaks on behalf of God and delivers His message to the people.
The kingdom of Israel, which during Solomon's reign was united but later split into two.
